title: How to Build a Discord Bot with AI: No Coding Required (2026)
summary: Build a fully functional Discord bot with welcome messages, slash commands, role management, auto-moderation, and a web dashboard — without writing discord.py or Node.js. Complete guide for 2026.
body_markdown: From your Blink project, add an AI integration: specify which channels get AI responses, set the system prompt that defines how the bot behaves, and add your AI provider API key as an environment variable. The bot routes messages in configured channels to the model and returns the response. You can switch models anytime from the dashboard.
